name: White Knight Pest Control
summary: Residential and commercial pest control, termite, mosquito, bed bug and rodent services from the White Knight Pest Control office on the Gulf Freeway in Houston.

hero.eyebrow: Guaranteed pest control services in Houston
hero.title: Pest control that comes back
hero.lead: Residential and commercial pest control since 2006. If you need us to come back out for any reason, we return within 24 to 48 hours at no additional charge.

highlights.title: Service Guarantee
highlights.text: If at any time you need us to come back out for any reason, we will return within 24-48 hours to address the issue with no additional charges.

highlights.title: Customized Treatment Plans
highlights.text: Every home and business is unique. We tailor a pest control plan to fit your specific needs and budget.

highlights.title: Free Termite Monitoring
highlights.text: All new pest control customers receive the Termi-Shield Termite Monitoring system installed and inspected for free.

groups.title: Home Pest Control
groups.summary: Monthly, bi-monthly and quarterly plans with the Platinum Shield 15-point protection.
groups.intro: Instead of offering one general plan to every customer, we offer three plans to choose from: monthly for the most aggressive approach, bi-monthly for frequent service, and quarterly for basic maintenance. Common pests such as spiders, scorpions, fire ants, wasps, earwigs, ticks, fleas and roaches are covered under our treatment plans without additional costs.

services.title: Initial Inspection & Service
services.text: Your technician goes over your pest concerns, then does an interior and exterior flush-out treatment that takes about an hour.
points: If activity has not subsided after ten days, we come back
An increase in activity right after treatment is normal as pests are flushed out

services.title: Maintenance Treatments
services.text: Regular treatments begin 30 days after your initial service, and we return every 30, 60 or 90 days depending on your plan.
points: Monthly, bi-monthly or quarterly plans
Gaps over 90 days raise the risk of new infestations

services.title: Platinum Shield 15-Point Protection
services.text: A 15-step process covering the yard and fence, the outside of the home and the inside of the home, including attic treatment.
points: Yard and flower beds treated for fire ants
10-12 foot perimeter power spray around the home
Baseboards, plumbing voids and appliances treated inside
Webs and wasp and mud dauber nests removed from accessible eaves

services.title: Service Guarantee
services.text: If you start seeing pests between your regularly scheduled services, we return to your home within one to two days of your call.

groups.title: Targeted Pest Control
groups.summary: Bed bug, mosquito, rodent, ant, German cockroach and gopher control, plus lawn services.
groups.intro: In addition to our general pest control plans, we offer targeted pest control services for a wide variety of pests.

services.title: Bed Bug Control
services.text: A visual inspection to confirm bed bugs, a preparation checklist before treatment, then treatment with liquids, dusts and aerosols. Room-by-room treatments are offered, and whole-house treatment is recommended.
points: Follow-up visit 10-14 days after the initial treatment
30-day service guarantee from the day of the initial treatment

services.title: Mosquito Control
services.text: A two-step system: we find and treat breeding sites, then apply a fine mist with a backpack blower that suppresses mosquito activity for up to 30 days.
points: Monthly service recommended April through October
Standing water that cannot be drained is treated

services.title: Rodent Control
services.text: An inspection to find activity and entry points, a customized plan with a quote, then bait boxes, traps or glue boards as needed.
points: Minor exclusion work to seal entry points

services.title: Ant Control
services.text: Targeted treatment for ant problems around your home.

services.title: German Cockroach Control
services.text: Targeted treatment for German cockroach infestations.

services.title: Gopher Control
services.text: Gopher control is one of our targeted pest services.

services.title: Lawn Services
services.text: Lawn services offered alongside our pest control plans.

groups.title: Termite Control
groups.summary: Termite inspections, Termidor and Trelona treatments, wood-destroying insect reports and the Termi-Shield warranty.
groups.intro: Whether you have an active termite problem or are ready to take preventative action, our technicians inspect, treat and help prevent termites. Treatment can take several hours to a full day depending on the method.

services.title: Termite Inspection
services.text: A technician inspects your home for visible termite activity or damage. If you have termites, you get a quote for treatment the same day as the inspection.
points: Wood-destroying insect reports
If no termites, we show you areas of the home conducive to termites

services.title: Termidor
services.text: Termidor Certified Professional applications, used in spot treatments and around the perimeter of your home.

services.title: Trelona ATBS
services.text: Trelona Advance Termite Bait System stations with the active ingredient Novaluron, which disrupts the growth of immature termites throughout the colony.

services.title: Termi-Shield Monitoring & Warranty
services.text: All new pest control customers receive Termi-Shield Termite Monitoring installed and inspected for free, checked each time we come out for your regular treatment.
points: Termi-Shield Termite Warranty available

groups.title: Commercial Pest Control
groups.summary: Customized pest control programs for businesses, with general and targeted treatments.
groups.intro: One of our most experienced technicians meets with you, looks around the property for entry points and conducive conditions, then writes up a proposal with pricing. Follow-up treatments run on the schedule set out in your proposal.

services.title: Custom Commercial Programs
services.text: Exterior and interior treatments aimed at the pests your business has been having trouble with, especially rodents and cockroaches.
points: Organic treatment options available upon request
Flexible scheduling options

services.text: We serve a wide range of industries.

Schools
Homeowners associations
Condos and apartment buildings
Warehouses
Churches

about.title: Service is the driving force behind everything we do
text: Founded in 2006 in Kyle, Texas, White Knight Pest Control was inspired by the idea of creating a company that would provide growth opportunities for employees with a strong desire and passion for serving others.

A white knight is someone who comes to the rescue when dire circumstances are at hand. Honesty, integrity, teamwork and commitment are the four cornerstones of our company, and families, ours and our customers', are what drive us.
Today we deliver residential and commercial pest control in Texas, Oklahoma, Colorado, California, Arizona, Minnesota, Alabama, Nevada and Utah.

values.title: Guaranteed Services
values.text: We guarantee all of our pest control services.

values.title: Flexible Scheduling
values.text: We offer flexible online scheduling for your convenience.

values.title: Pest-Specific Options
values.text: General pest control or one pest targeted, we have you covered.

faqs.a: If your goal is to both rid your business of active pests and keep pests out in the future, recurring services are essential. Our treatments begin to break down over time, so ongoing service keeps your property protected.

faqs.q: Can pest control get rid of mosquitoes?
faqs.a: No pest control treatment will eliminate mosquitoes entirely. With our two-step mosquito control service, we can greatly reduce their numbers on your property and keep them low with monthly re-treatments.

faqs.q: How do you control bed bugs?
faqs.a: We offer professional bed bug control with a 30-day guarantee. We use a combination of liquids, dusts and aerosols, and we return 10-14 days after your initial treatment to inspect and re-treat if necessary.

faqs.q: How long does a termite treatment take?
faqs.a: Depending on the type of treatment necessary, it may take several hours to a full day to complete your termite control treatment.
